general.description: The Norma Core Guard is a military Station that host a multi-clanic elite garnison in charge to defend the border of the Rithai Kemae. This was once a more or less abandonned Irmothem station, but the Rith Core Council decided to retook it to control the sector, just in the border of the Irilia Sphere.
general.bar: Elite Rithai guards from all possible clans, echanging about the actualities during their shifts.
